categories.main_business_segments: The company's primary business is the research and development and sales of video surveillance chips. The products are mainly applied in three key segments: intelligent security surveillance (IPC SoC and NVR/XVR SoC), video intercom systems, and intelligent vehicle-mounted applications (CAR DVR). The company operates as a fabless semiconductor design enterprise, focusing on chip design while outsourcing manufacturing, packaging, and testing to third-party service providers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core technologies including Image Signal Processing (ISP), AI processor technology, multi-mode video encoding/decoding technology, high-speed analog circuit technology, and advanced process SoC chip design technology. The company has developed proprietary AI processor instruction sets, IP cores, and complete software tool chains. It utilizes the fabless model, outsourcing wafer fabrication to foundries and packaging/testing to specialized service providers while maintaining full control over chip design and quality assurance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves leading security brands in the intelligent security surveillance market, mainstream video intercom enterprises globally, and known vehicle-mounted vision manufacturers. Key customer segments include professional security, consumer security, video intercom systems, and automotive applications. The company has accumulated extensive end-customer resources across both domestic and international markets, with significant customer concentration in the top five customers representing 87.04% of annual sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with major presence in mainland China (Xiamen headquarters, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Hangzhou, Chengdu offices), Taiwan (branch office), and international markets. Domestic sales represented 76.53% of revenue while overseas sales accounted for 23.47% in 2023. The company maintains research and development teams in Xiamen, Shanghai, and Shenzhen, with subsidiaries and branch offices strategically located to serve both domestic and international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the semiconductor supply chain as a fabless chip design enterprise. It is positioned between upstream wafer manufacturers and downstream system integrators/end customers. The company handles chip design, specification, and quality control while relying on external partners for wafer fabrication (TSMC, Samsung, etc.), packaging, and testing services. It maintains direct relationships with major customers through both direct sales and distribution channels.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic priorities include: (1) advancing AI processor IP development to the fourth generation with improved algorithm compatibility and energy efficiency; (2) developing next-generation ISP technology supporting 8K60fps processing with AI-enhanced noise reduction; (3) expanding video encoding technology to support 8K60fps with AI-optimized bitrate allocation; (4) enhancing product lines across intelligent security, video intercom, and intelligent vehicle-mounted segments; (5) pursuing international market expansion and becoming a globally influential chip design company; (6) developing edge computing solutions and multi-camera technologies for emerging applications.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of video surveillance chips across three main segments: intelligent security surveillance chips (71.39% of 2023 revenue), video intercom chips (16.95%), and intelligent vehicle-mounted chips (9.25%). Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of the chips, typically upon delivery to agreed locations. The company employs a mixed sales model combining distribution (90.12% of sales) and direct sales (9.88%), with 76.53% of revenue from domestic markets and 23.47% from overseas markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include international companies such as Ambarella and Techwell, and domestic competitors including Huawei HiSilicon, Fullhan Microelectronics, Beijing Zhoujin, Cambrian, Rockchip, and Guoke Microelectronics. The company positions itself as a market leader in video surveillance chip design with the most comprehensive domestic product line portfolio. Based on shipment volume metrics, the company maintains leading positions in its target segments. The company differentiates through superior technical capabilities, complete product line coverage, strong customer relationships, and excellent customer service.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized semiconductor design enterprise with 2023 revenue of 2,020.43 million RMB (down 14.66% from 2022's 2,367.53 million RMB). Net profit attributable to parent company shareholders was 204.71 million RMB in 2023 (down 63.72% from 564.31 million RMB in 2022). Total assets reached 3,440.07 million RMB at year-end 2023 (up 41.43% from 2,432.42 million RMB in 2022). The company went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange's ChiNext board on March 28, 2024, issuing 42.11 million shares at 16.16 RMB per share. The company is experiencing cyclical pressure from industry downturn but maintains strong R&D investment and asset growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's competitive differentiation centers on: (1) proprietary AI processor technology with self-developed instruction sets, IP cores, and complete tool chains, providing superior algorithm compatibility and energy efficiency; (2) advanced ISP technology enabling high-quality image processing in challenging lighting conditions with features like 3DNR, 2DNR, and RGB-IR color restoration; (3) comprehensive product portfolio spanning multiple application segments (security, intercom, automotive) with the most complete domestic product line; (4) strong technical service capabilities and customer-centric approach with dedicated support teams; (5) superior price-to-performance ratio combining advanced technology with cost-effective solutions; (6) proven track record with leading global customers and strong brand reputation in the industry.
